summary: Preserve native MXFP8 expert activations for DS4.1 CSF checkpoints
compatibility: Install the paired B12X MXFP8-CSF preparation update. Checkpoint files and launch flags are unchanged. Expert results can differ from the previous BF16 CSF execution because the native activation quantizer is restored.
details: DS4.1 CSF uses MXFP8 expert activations unless VLLM_B12X_MOE_FP4_FORCE_A16=1 requests BF16, matching the native MXFP4 backend policy.
Attention precision, logits precision, dense layers and Kimi BF16 expert activations are unchanged.
Checkpoint loading remains in vLLM and invokes ordinary B12X weight preparation.
